skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply auditing principles and practices in various organizational settings.
Analyze and evaluate financial statements and reports.
Conduct independent research and write comprehensive reports.
Critically assess and provide recommendations on auditing and internal control practices.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations through written and oral presentations.
Understand and apply relevant laws and regulations in auditing and internal control.
Use basic IT skills for data analysis and report preparation.
Make ethical decisions in professional auditing and internal control contexts.
Work independently and collaboratively in a team setting.
